text:
Alex: Quick poll — what's our canonical protocol for measuring p95/p99 when comparing replay vs synthetic? We're seeing tails that only show up in replays.
Priya: My take: replays need to include KV-warmup windows and prefix overlap. Synth workloads usually miss that.
Jordan: We also need to align microbatch config. Microbatch=4 vs 16 changes latency distribution a lot.
Taylor: Agree. Also kernel selection matters — large-batch kernels reduce p99 if sequence lengths are short, but blow up p95 on long tails.
Alex: Example from yesterday: replayed trace with real user prefixes => p99 jumped 2.1x. Synth with same qps stayed flat.
Priya: Did you capture KV cache hit-rate over the trace? If hits ramped up mid-trace, that affects batching behaviour.
Alex: Yes — attached in channel (see later). Hit-rate moved from 12% -> 65% during a 30s window.
perfbot: perfbot: regression-alert: model=v2.3 kernel=matmul-opt, p99 increase +110% in canary
Jordan: That's the kernel flagged. If matmul-opt switches to tiled path for L>1024 it triggers different memory pattern.
Taylor: For methodology I'd propose: 1) run replay with cold-start and warm cycles, 2) include KV warming, 3) run synth variants that emulate prefix overlap and variable seq-len, 4) report both p95 and p99 with percentile CI.
Priya: +1. Also record batching micro-metrics: microbatch size distribution, per-microbatch latency, queue wait time.
Alex: Can we add a short recipe in repo? Something like:
```
# loadgen snippet
--mode replay --trace /traces/session-2026-02.json \
--microbatch_target 8 --kv_warmup 30s --measure_percentiles 95,99
```
Jordan: And for synth, use poisson arrivals + prefix-replay generator to mimic reuse.
Taylor: We should avoid burying p99 in averages — add tail-guardrails: p99 < 200ms or fallback to cheaper model.
Alex: Ops question: do we use the same kernel selection policy in replay as in prod routing? We must ensure routing logic identical.
Priya: We also need to surface kernel-switch telemetry in console for each run.
perfbot: perfbot: note: a/b test canary shows kernel matmul-opt passes throughput SLO but fails tail SLO consistently
Jordan: Action items: (Alex) produce a short benchmark recipe PR; (Priya) add KV-hit and microbatch histos to benchmark output; (Taylor) add kernel-telemetry flag to loadgen; (Jordan) analyze matmul-opt memory path for long seqs.
Alex: I'll open PR today. Keeping it minimal.
Taylor: If anyone wants to pair on the memory-path analysis ping me.
Priya: Also capture p95 CI with bootstrap resampling. Helps avoid noise from single-run spikes.
Alex: Cool — let's reconvene after PR and a single-run replay + synth comparison.
Taylor: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :+1:
